tools.name: get_marketing_setup_guide
tools.description: Get a first analytics and search setup checklist tailored to the market and conversion goal. Works without a Qonvert account.

tools.name: check_marketing_tracking_url
tools.description: Inspect tracking parameter names in one supplied HTTP(S) URL without opening it. Works without a Qonvert account.

tools.name: get_free_placement_guidance
tools.description: Get free curated placement guidance. Provide the business type, stage, market, language and goal using the listed choices. Provide public_mcp for an MCP server or in_person for a local service.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get the project authorized by the user. Additional consent required: qonvert.read

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List connected sources for the authorized project. Additional consent required: qonvert.read

tools.name: get_marketing_measurement_readiness
tools.description: Check authorized marketing sources and observed click-ID gaps. Optionally inspect supplied URL tags without visiting those URLs. Never changes tracking or budgets. Additional consent required: qonvert.read

tools.name: adsy_campaign_request
tools.description: Ask Qonvert to start or continue a Google Ads request using a website URL or the saved project site. Reuse the same request_id on each follow-up; provide only confirmed answers. Saves a brief for native approval; never runs research or ads. Additional consent required: qonvert.campaigns, qonvert.rea

tools.name: get_campaign_brief_status
tools.description: Read the status of a campaign brief prepared by this grant. Additional consent required: qonvert.campaigns, qonvert.read
